units.source_text: 良平跑进自己家之后，终于忍不住“哇”的一声哭了出来。

en.t: After Ryōhei ran into his own house, he finally could not hold back and burst out crying with a loud wail.

units.source_text: 哭声一下子让父母亲的都跑到良平身边来了。

en.t: At the sound of his crying, both his father and mother immediately ran to Ryōhei's side.

units.source_text: 尤其是母亲，她抱着良平不住的安慰。

en.t: His mother especially held Ryōhei in her arms and kept trying to comfort him.

units.source_text: 可是良平却手脚不住的折腾，哭个不停。

en.t: But Ryōhei thrashed his arms and legs and went on crying without stopping.

units.source_text: 可能是良平的哭声太激烈了，住在附近的三四个妇女也来到良平家昏暗的大门口来了。

en.t: Perhaps Ryōhei's crying was so violent that three or four women from nearby also came to the dim entrance of his house.

units.source_text: 父母亲自不必多说，就连门口的邻人也都一直问他哭的原因。

en.t: Needless to say, his parents asked him why he was crying, and even the neighbors at the doorway kept asking too.

units.source_text: 不过不管别人问什么，良平除了一门心思的嚎啕大哭之外，什么也不说。

en.t: But no matter what anyone asked, Ryōhei said nothing and only cried his heart out.

units.source_text: 从那么遥远的地方提着一口气跑回家，

en.t: Having run all the way home from such a faraway place while holding his breath,

units.source_text: 只要想到自己路上经历的种种，良平觉得，

en.t: whenever he thought of everything he had gone through on the way, Ryōhei felt that

units.source_text: 不管自己怎么痛苦，总有一种无法释怀情绪堵在自己心理……

en.t: no matter how much he suffered, there was always some feeling he could not let go of lodged in his heart...
